queries.snapshot:
EVALUATE ROW(
  "as_at", MAX('REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3'[UPDATED_ON]),
  "snapshot_cardinality", DISTINCTCOUNT('REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3'[UPDATED_ON]),
  "rows", CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3'), 'REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3'[LOC_CODE] IN {"ST1", "ST2", "ST3", "ST4", "ST5"}),
  "skus", CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3'[SKU_CODE]), 'REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3'[LOC_CODE] IN {"ST1", "ST2", "ST3", "ST4", "ST5"}),
  "locations", CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3'[LOC_CODE]), 'REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3'[LOC_CODE] IN {"ST1", "ST2", "ST3", "ST4", "ST5"}),
  "total_stock_value", CALCULATE(SUM('REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3'[SKU_STOCK_VALUE]), 'REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3'[LOC_CODE] IN {"ST1", "ST2", "ST3", "ST4", "ST5"}),
  "total_excess_value", CALCULATE(SUM('REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3'[EXCESS_STOCK_VALUE]), 'REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3'[LOC_CODE] IN {"ST1", "ST2", "ST3", "ST4", "ST5"}),
  "total_pending_value", CALCULATE(SUM('REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3'[PENDING_ORDERS_VALUE]), 'REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3'[LOC_CODE] IN {"ST1", "ST2", "ST3", "ST4", "ST5"}),
  "total_opp_loss", CALCULATE(SUM('REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3'[OPP_LOSS_DUE_TO_STOCKOUT]), 'REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3'[LOC_CODE] IN {"ST1", "ST2", "ST3", "ST4", "ST5"})
)

queries.deep__lowest_burnout:
EVALUATE
TOPN(8,
  FILTER(
    CALCULATETABLE(
      SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
        'REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3'[SKU_CODE], 'REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3'[PART_DESCRIPTION], 'REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3'[LOC_CODE],
        "burnout", MIN('REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3'[EXPECTED_BURNOUT_DAYS]),
        "value", SUM('REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3'[SKU_STOCK_VALUE])
      ),
      'REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3'[LOC_CODE] IN {"ST1", "ST2", "ST3", "ST4", "ST5"}
    ),
    [burnout] > 0 && [burnout] < 1000 && [value] > 0
  ),
  [burnout], ASC, 'REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3'[SKU_CODE], ASC)
